name: tally
description: Self-hosted personal finance for UK Open Banking (TrueLayer) — one-click deploy to Google Cloud Run.

TALLY_MASTER_KEY.description: Encrypts your bank tokens at rest. A secure random value is generated for you — just accept it. Keep it safe: changing it later makes already-saved data unreadable.

TALLY_TRUELAYER_CLIENT_ID.description: TrueLayer Live application client id (from console.truelayer.com).

TALLY_DATABASE_URL.description: Default file:/app/data/state.db is EPHEMERAL on Cloud Run — wiped on every cold start, fine for a quick test. For durable data, set a Turso URL like libsql://YOUR-DB.turso.io and fill TALLY_DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN below.

TALLY_DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Turso database auth token. Only needed when TALLY_DATABASE_URL is a libsql:// URL.

TALLY_REDIRECT_URI_BASE.description: Public base URL TrueLayer redirects back to, e.g. https://YOUR-SERVICE.run.app/auth . You get the run.app URL only AFTER the first deploy — leave blank now, then set it (and add it to your TrueLayer app's redirect URIs) and redeploy before linking a bank.

TALLY_ENABLE_REMINDERS.description: Background reminders + Telegram + periodic bank sync. Off for serverless (a scale-to-zero host can't run the background loop reliably).

TALLY_SECURE_COOKIES.description: Keep true — Cloud Run always serves HTTPS.

TALLY_TRUST_PROXY.description: Keep true — Cloud Run (and IAP) front the app, so rate-limit keys read X-Forwarded-For.

TALLY_OIDC_ISSUER.description: Optional. Set (with the two below) only if you front /mcp with an OIDC provider to enable the AI/MCP connector. Leave blank and /mcp simply rejects everything.

TALLY_OIDC_AUDIENCE.description: Optional. OIDC audience for the /mcp connector.

TALLY_OIDC_JWKS_URL.description: Optional. OIDC JWKS URL for the /mcp connector.
